data.value.autotriggeronevent.descriptio: Action will be triggered when an event is happening on a particular unit. Options: created, completeAndActive, destroyed, killedAnyUnit, queuedUnitFinished, queueItemAdded(withActionTag="#"), queueItemCancelled(withActionTag="#"), teleported, touchTargetSuccess, newWaypointGivenByPlayer, teamChanged, transportingNewUnit, transportUnloadedOrRemovedUnit, tookDamage(withTag="#"), newMessage(withTag="#"), enteredTransport, leftTransport, attachmentRemoved. withTag parameter for tookDamage uses tag from projectile and it is optional. withTag parameter for newMessage uses message tags.
data.value.autotriggeronevent.created.de: Triggered when the unit is first created
data.value.autotriggeronevent.completean: Triggered when the unit is fully built and becomes active
Triggered when the unit is destroyed
data.value.autotriggeronevent.killedanyu: Triggered when this unit kills any other unit
data.value.autotriggeronevent.queuedunit: Triggered when a queued unit is completed
data.value.autotriggeronevent.queueitema: Triggered when an action is added to the queue with a specific action tag
data.value.autotriggeronevent.queueitemc: Triggered when an action is cancelled from the queue with a specific action tag
data.value.autotriggeronevent.teleported: Triggered when the unit is teleported
data.value.autotriggeronevent.touchtarge: Triggered when the unit successfully touches its target
data.value.autotriggeronevent.newwaypoin: Triggered when a new waypoint is given by the player
data.value.autotriggeronevent.teamchange: Triggered when the unit changes teams
data.value.autotriggeronevent.transporti: Triggered when the unit starts transporting a new unit
data.value.autotriggeronevent.transportu: Triggered when a unit is unloaded or removed from transport
data.value.autotriggeronevent.tookdamage: Triggered when the unit takes damage with a specific tag
data.value.autotriggeronevent.newmessage: Triggered when the unit receives a new message with a specific tag
data.value.autotriggeronevent.enteredtra: Triggered when the unit enters a transport
data.value.autotriggeronevent.lefttransp: Triggered when the unit leaves a transport
data.value.autotriggeronevent.attachment: Triggered when an attachment is removed from the unit
The tag of the action that was added or cancelled
The tag from the projectile that caused the damage (optional)
The tag of the message received
